name: bunch
description: Split a large or exploratory task into stages and work through them, logging progress and course corrections in a Bunch Document with one Task Document per task.

interface.shortDescription: Work through a large task in logged stages
interface.longDescription: Split a large or exploratory task into stages. A Bunch Document holds the goal, rules, task list and timeline; each task gets a Task Document with its goal, done-when conditions, context and work log, so the work keeps its course and stays easy to follow.
